create_seq2seq_batch_from_pb: create a Seq2SeqLMBatch from a protobuf Batch message with tokenizer and device parameters
filter_seq2seq_batch: filter a Seq2SeqLMBatch to keep only requests matching the given request IDs list
concatenate_seq2seq_batches: concatenate multiple Seq2SeqLMBatch instances into a single batch with padded tensors
generate_token_seq2seq: generate the next token for a Seq2SeqLMBatch using forward pass and token selection
load_seq2seq_model: load a Seq2SeqLM model with optional quantization and distributed setup from a model ID
